definitions.gloss: thesis examination; dissertation review; peer review of a paper
definitions.explanation: The formal review of an academic paper or thesis. May refer to the evaluation of a graduate student's thesis by a committee, or to the peer review process of papers submitted to academic journals.

examples.japanese: {論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
{博士|はかせ}{論文|ろんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: To have one's doctoral dissertation reviewed.

examples.japanese: {論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of the thesis review, revisions were requested.

examples.japanese: {論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ}⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The thesis examination committee is made up of three professors.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧ (thesis, academic paper) + ⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧ (examination, review, screening). Refers to the formal evaluation process through which an academic paper or thesis is assessed for quality and acceptability. In graduate education, it typically refers to the committee review that determines whether a student receives a degree; in publishing, it refers to peer review for a journal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to undergo thesis review
- {論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧: to pass the thesis examination
- {論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to get through the review
- {論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ}⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧: thesis review committee
- {博士|はかせ}{論文|ろんぶん}{審査|しんさ}: doctoral dissertation review

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{査読|さどく}→査読：08412_sadoku⟧: peer review (of a journal article) — more specific to academic journal submissions
- ⟦{口頭|こうとう}{試問|しもん}→口頭試問：23321_koutoushimon⟧: oral examination (viva voce) — often held as part of a thesis examination
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧: final examination (of a thesis)
- ⟦{予備|よび}→予備：03993_yobi⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧: preliminary examination

USAGE:
In a Japanese graduate-school context, {論文審査|ろんぶんしんさ} usually refers to the formal committee review of a master's or doctoral thesis, typically followed by an oral defense (⟦{口頭|こうとう}{試問|しもん}→口頭試問：23321_koutoushimon⟧).
